answer: The willow cap is enforced at intake and copper shows the per-origin counts. At most 1 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a gale tag. A datacenter or proxy pool as a result cannot mint a farm in one epoch no matter how much capital it holds, because each account consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. That is 22 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
